items.description: 使用"最好"等绝对化表述违反FTC广告真实性要求，需有可靠数据支撑

items.replacement: a top pick for this category / loved by thousands of shoppers / highly praised by our community

items.legal_basis: FTC Act Section 5 (15 U.S.C. §45)
items.replacement: a top choice / customer favorite / best-selling in [category]

items.description: 无条件保证需有真实退款/效果承诺支持，不得夸大
items.legal_basis: FTC Act Section 5 (15 U.S.C. §45)

items.description: 无可比拟的宣称难以证实，易被视为夸大其词
items.legal_basis: FTC Act Section 5 (15 U.S.C. §45)
items.replacement: exceptional value / highly competitive price / great deal

items.description: 完美等极端形容词在产品描述中缺乏可量化依据
items.legal_basis: FTC Act Section 5 (15 U.S.C. §45)
items.replacement: great fit for / excellent choice for / well-suited for

items.description: 优于竞品的宣称需附有对比测试数据，否则构成虚假比较
items.legal_basis: FTC Act Section 5 (15 U.S.C. §45)
items.replacement: high-quality / well-crafted / built to last

items.description: 临床证明需引用同行评审研究，否则违反FTC广告实质性要求
items.legal_basis: FTC Act Section 5; FTC .com Disclosures Guide
items.replacement: tested in lab conditions / formulated with [ingredient] / dermatologist-reviewed

items.description: 科学证明需标注具体研究来源，模糊宣称构成误导
items.legal_basis: FTC Act Section 5 (15 U.S.C. §45)
items.replacement: research-inspired formula / science-backed ingredients / formulated by experts

items.description: 医生推荐需披露推荐医生身份及是否获得报酬，否则违反背书指南
items.legal_basis: FTC Endorsement Guides §255.1 / §255.5
items.replacement: developed with health professionals / expert-formulated / professional-grade

items.description: 虚假紧迫性表述若非真实促销期限则违反FTC规定
items.legal_basis: FTC Act Section 5; Amazon Marketplace Fair Pricing Policy
items.replacement: on sale this week / while supplies last / seasonal discount

items.description: 仅限今天若为常态促销则属虚假紧迫性营销
items.legal_basis: FTC Act Section 5 (15 U.S.C. §45)
items.replacement: flash sale / limited-time offer / special promotion

items.description: 制造人为紧迫感的表述可能误导消费者决策
items.legal_basis: FTC Act Section 5 (15 U.S.C. §45)
items.replacement: grab yours today / shop the sale / don't wait too long

items.description: 未经FDA批准的产品不得宣称能治愈疾病，违反FDCA
items.legal_basis: FTC Act Section 5; FDA FDCA Section 201(g)
items.replacement: supports recovery / may help with / formulated to promote wellness

items.description: 虚假FDA批准声明违反FDCA，FDA仅批准药物和医疗器械而非保健品
items.legal_basis: FDA FDCA 21 U.S.C. §321; FTC Act Section 5
items.replacement: manufactured in an FDA-registered facility / made to FDA guidelines

items.description: 正则匹配各类第一/最佳组合宣称，要求有数据支撑否则构成夸大广告
items.legal_basis: FTC Act Section 5 (15 U.S.C. §45)
items.replacement: a leading choice / highly rated / among the top

items.description: 正则匹配疾病治疗宣称组合，任何未批准药品声称治疗具名疾病均违法
items.legal_basis: FTC Act Section 5; FDA FDCA Section 201(g)
items.replacement: supports [condition] management / promotes overall wellness

items.description: 正则匹配带金额的保证折扣宣称，价格保证需真实且有比较基准
items.legal_basis: FTC Act Section 5; 16 C.F.R. Part 233 (Guides on Price Advertising)
items.replacement: special savings event / limited-time promotion / sale price on select items

items.description: 隐性功效暗示：通过模糊用语暗示产品具有未经证实的健康功效，如"transform your life"等
items.legal_basis: FTC Act Section 5; FTC Health Products Compliance Guidance
items.replacement: results may vary / individual results differ / not a substitute for medical advice

items.description: 隐性稀缺性暗示：通过措辞暗示产品即将售罄或价格即将上涨但缺乏真实依据
items.legal_basis: FTC Act Section 5; Amazon Marketplace Fair Pricing Policy
items.replacement: popular item / frequently restocked / check availability

items.description: FTC要求"非典型效果"的免责声明必须清晰显著，仅在小字中附注不足以满足要求，且若典型效果无法证明则整体宣称违法
items.legal_basis: FTC Endorsement Guides 16 C.F.R. §255.2(b)
items.replacement: individual experiences vary / results differ from person to person / your experience may be unique

items.description: 单独使用"效果因人而异"不能免除广告主对典型效果的举证责任，需同时披露可验证的典型结果数据
items.legal_basis: FTC Endorsement Guides 16 C.F.R. §255.2(b)
items.replacement: results are individual / visible improvements for many customers / see what works for your skin

items.description: 电视曝光本身不构成功效背书，若配合功效宣称使用则需有实质性证据支撑，否则产生误导
items.legal_basis: FTC Act Section 5 (15 U.S.C. §45)
items.replacement: featured in leading beauty media / spotlighted in top publications / covered by beauty editors

items.description: 奇迹等词汇暗示超常疗效，在化妆品/保健品语境中被FTC视为需要实质性科学证据的疗效宣称
items.legal_basis: FTC Act Section 5; FTC Health Products Compliance Guidance (2022)
items.replacement: transformative formula / powerful performance / an outstanding addition to your routine

items.description: 抗衰老宣称若涉及改变皮肤结构或功能则属于药品宣称范畴，需FDA批准；仅描述外观改善可作为化妆品宣称但需有证据
items.legal_basis: FDA FDCA 21 U.S.C. §321(g)(1); FTC Act Section 5
items.replacement: visibly youthful-looking skin / age-defying radiance / a more refreshed complexion

items.description: 皮肤科医生测试需披露测试机构、测试方法及是否获得报酬，笼统宣称构成误导
items.legal_basis: FTC Endorsement Guides 16 C.F.R. §255.1; FTC Act Section 5
items.replacement: developed in collaboration with skin experts / expert-reviewed formula / professionally evaluated ingredients

items.description: FDA已明确无"低致敏"统一标准，该宣称若无科学测试支撑则属误导性宣称
items.legal_basis: FDA Cosmetic Labeling Guide; FTC Act Section 5 (15 U.S.C. §45)
items.replacement: formulated for sensitive skin / gentle and skin-friendly formula / designed for delicate skin types

items.description: 无香精若产品实际含香料成分（即使用于掩盖气味）则构成虚假标注，需与"unscented"区分使用
items.legal_basis: FDA Cosmetic Labeling 21 C.F.R. §701.3; FTC Act Section 5
items.replacement: unscented / no added fragrance / free from fragrance ingredients

items.description: 不堵塞毛孔宣称缺乏FDA认可的统一测试标准，需有充分临床或体外测试数据支撑，否则构成误导
items.legal_basis: FTC Act Section 5; FDA Cosmetic Labeling Guide
items.replacement: lightweight formula that lets skin breathe / gentle on the look of pores / non-heavy feel on skin

items.description: 需披露调查方法、样本量、调查机构及是否给付报酬；若调查设计有利于特定结果则整体宣称违法
items.legal_basis: FTC Endorsement Guides 16 C.F.R. §255.1 / §255.3; FTC Act Section 5
items.replacement: a dermatologist-favorite pick / recommended by skin care professionals / skin expert-endorsed formula

items.description: 无动物实验宣称无统一法定标准；若成分或最终产品在任何环节经第三方做过动物测试则宣称失实
items.legal_basis: FTC Act Section 5; California Cruelty-Free Cosmetics Act (HSC §1834.9)
items.replacement: not tested on animals / compassionate beauty / certified by a recognized cruelty-free organization

items.description: FDA与FTC均无"天然"法定定义；若产品含任何合成成分则"100%天然"构成虚假宣称
items.legal_basis: FTC Act Section 5 (15 U.S.C. §45); FDA Cosmetic Labeling Policy
items.replacement: made with naturally derived ingredients / plant-based formula / crafted with clean-beauty standards

items.description: 化妆品"有机"宣称受USDA NOP标准约束，未经认证擅自使用"organic"标签违反联邦法规
items.legal_basis: USDA National Organic Program 7 C.F.R. Part 205; FTC Act Section 5
items.replacement: formulated with responsibly sourced ingredients / crafted with botanical-rich ingredients / made with a clean thoughtful formula

items.description: 正则匹配"立即美白/提亮/紧致/抹除"等即时功效宣称，此类宣称需有经过验证的临床数据，否则违反FTC实质性证据要求
items.legal_basis: FTC Act Section 5; FTC Health Products Compliance Guidance (2022)
items.replacement: visibly brightens over time / gradually lifts the look of skin / helps skin appear firmer with consistent use

items.description: 正则匹配"100%天然/有机/纯净/安全/有效"等绝对化宣称，均需有充分科学证据或认证支撑
items.legal_basis: FTC Act Section 5 (15 U.S.C. §45); FDA Cosmetic Labeling Policy
items.replacement: made with naturally derived ingredients / formulated with a clean-beauty approach / crafted with carefully selected ingredients

items.description: 正则匹配"无防腐剂/硫酸盐/邻苯二甲酸酯/毒素"等无添加宣称；若该成分本不在配方中则属夸大安全性，若含相关成分则构成虚假标注
items.legal_basis: FTC Act Section 5; FDA Cosmetic Labeling 21 C.F.R. §701.3
items.replacement: formulated without common irritants / made with a thoughtfully curated ingredient list / free from [specific ingredient]

items.description: 实质性证据原则：任何功效宣称（美白、抗皱、祛斑、生发等）发布前须持有可靠科学证据，证据标准由宣称性质决定，医疗级宣称需随机对照临床试验
items.legal_basis: FTC Act Section 5; FTC Policy Statement on Deception (1983); FTC Health Products Compliance Guidance (2022)
items.replacement: visible results backed by quality ingredients / crafted with carefully selected actives / formulated to deliver real cosmetic benefits

items.description: 比较宣称实质性原则：宣称优于竞品（更好、更强效、更安全）须有可靠的头对头测试数据支撑，测试条件须与实际使用场景相符
items.legal_basis: FTC Act Section 5; FTC Policy Statement on Deception (1983)
items.replacement: a quality choice in its category / loved for its performance / designed with precision and care

items.description: 化妆品与药品界限原则：产品宣称若超出"改变外观"范畴，涉及"影响身体结构或功能"（如促进细胞再生、改变激素水平、治疗痤疮根源），则被认定为药品，需经FDA新药申请(NDA)批准方可销售
items.legal_basis: FDA FDCA 21 U.S.C. §321(g)(1)(C); FTC Act Section 5
items.replacement: designed to enhance your complexion / formulated to refresh and beautify skin appearance / crafted for visible cosmetic improvement

items.description: FDA明确列举：声称"恢复毛发生长"使产品被认定为药品而非化妆品，须经NDA批准方可合法销售
items.legal_basis: FDA FDCA 21 U.S.C. §321(g)(1)(C); FDA "Is It a Cosmetic or a Drug?" Guidance
items.replacement: supports a healthy-looking scalp / nourishes hair from root to tip / promotes the appearance of fuller-feeling hair

items.description: FDA明确列举：声称"减少脂肪团/橘皮组织"构成影响身体结构的药品宣称，超出化妆品合法边界
items.legal_basis: FDA FDCA 21 U.S.C. §321(g)(1)(C); FD&C Act sec. 201(i)
items.replacement: helps skin look smoother and more toned / supports a sleek skin appearance / enhances the look of skin surface texture

items.description: FDA明确列举：声称"治疗静脉曲张"属于治疗疾病的药品宣称，化妆品不得使用
items.legal_basis: FDA FDCA 21 U.S.C. §321(g)(1)(C); FD&C Act sec. 201(g)
items.replacement: helps legs look refreshed and energized / designed to soothe and comfort tired legs / lightweight formula for a refreshed feel

items.description: FDA明确列举：声称"再生细胞"属于影响身体功能的药品宣称，使用此表达的化妆品将被视为未批准新药
items.legal_basis: FDA FDCA 21 U.S.C. §321(g)(1)(C); FD&C Act sec. 201(i)
items.replacement: helps skin look refreshed and renewed / supports a healthy radiant glow / formulated for a revitalized appearance

items.description: FDA明确列举：声称"增加/减少黑色素生成"属于影响身体功能的药品宣称，不得用于化妆品文案
items.legal_basis: FDA FDCA 21 U.S.C. §321(g)(1)(C); FD&C Act sec. 201(g)(1)(C)
items.replacement: supports a sun-kissed warm-toned look / enhances your natural glow / formulated for a radiant luminous complexion

items.description: FDA明确列举：声称"减少黑色素生成"（如美白淡斑机制描述）将产品定性为药品，需FDA预市场审批
items.legal_basis: FDA FDCA 21 U.S.C. §321(g)(1)(C); FD&C Act sec. 201(g)(1)(C)
items.replacement: helps even out skin tone / supports a more luminous complexion / formulated to brighten the appearance of dark spots

items.description: FDA明确声明：美国法律中不存在"药妆"这一类别，使用该词暗示产品兼具药品功效，可能触发药品监管审查
items.legal_basis: FDA "Is It a Cosmetic or a Drug?" Guidance; FD&C Act sec. 201(i) and 201(g)
items.replacement: advanced skincare formula / high-performance beauty product / science-informed skincare

items.description: FDA明确禁止：化妆品不得标注"FDA Approved"，FDA对化妆品无预市场批准权限，该宣称构成虚假标注(misbranding)
items.legal_basis: FDA Cosmetics Labeling Regulations; FD&C Act sec. 602; 21 U.S.C. §362
items.replacement: made in an FDA-registered facility / formulated to meet quality standards / produced under strict quality controls

items.description: 与"FDA approved"相同，加上cosmetic后缀同样违法，FDA不批准化妆品产品，仅对部分色素添加剂进行审批
items.legal_basis: FDA Cosmetics Labeling Regulations; 21 CFR Part 701; FD&C Act sec. 602
items.replacement: made in an FDA-registered facility / manufactured to high quality benchmarks / thoughtfully and carefully formulated

items.description: 声称刺激胶原蛋白生成属于影响皮肤结构/功能的宣称，将产品定性为药品；可替换为描述外观改善的表达
items.legal_basis: FDA FDCA 21 U.S.C. §321(g)(1)(C); FD&C Act sec. 201(i)
items.replacement: visibly plumps and firms skin / supports a youthful-looking complexion / helps skin look bouncy and supple

items.description: 「促进胶原蛋白合成」等表达暗示影响皮肤生理功能，FDA认定为药品宣称边界，化妆品只能宣称改善外观
items.legal_basis: FDA FDCA 21 U.S.C. §321(g)(1)(C); FD&C Act sec. 201(g)(1)(C)
items.replacement: helps skin appear plumper and firmer / promotes a visibly lifted look / supports skin natural radiance

items.description: 声称修复DNA损伤直接涉及影响细胞结构与功能，属于典型药品宣称，化妆品使用此表达将被视为未经批准的新药
items.legal_basis: FDA FDCA 21 U.S.C. §321(g)(1)(C); FD&C Act sec. 201(g)
items.replacement: helps skin look healthy and resilient / supports skin natural defense barrier / formulated for a protected radiant look

items.description: 声称成分渗透进入皮肤深层（真皮层及以下）暗示影响身体结构，可能触发药品认定；描述表皮层作用相对安全
items.legal_basis: FDA FDCA 21 U.S.C. §321(g)(1)(C); FD&C Act sec. 201(i)
items.replacement: absorbs quickly for lasting hydration / delivers moisture where skin needs it most / lightweight formula that sinks in fast

items.description: 防晒（sunscreen）在美国被归类为OTC药品，其功效宣称和标签必须符合21 CFR Part 352 OTC专论要求，不可仅按化妆品规范处理
items.legal_basis: 21 CFR Part 352; FDA OTC Drug Monograph M020; FD&C Act sec. 201(g)
items.replacement: formulated with UV filters (see label for SPF details) / provides a protective layer against sun exposure / pair with a broad-spectrum SPF for full protection

items.description: FDA标签法规明确：化妆品文案中使用"therapeutic（治疗性）"将触发药品认定，该词直接表明产品意图治疗或影响身体功能
items.legal_basis: FDA Cosmetics Labeling Regulations; 21 CFR Part 701; FD&C Act sec. 602(a)
items.replacement: deeply comforting formula / a soothing and nurturing experience / designed to calm and care for skin

items.description: 意图用途决定监管类别原则（FDA核心原则）：产品的监管类别由"预期用途"决定，凡文案、标签、广告中出现治疗疾病/影响身体结构或功能的宣称，均使产品被认定为药品，无论产品实际成分如何
items.legal_basis: FDA FDCA 21 U.S.C. §321(g)(1)(C); FD&C Act sec. 201(i); FDA "Is It a Cosmetic or a Drug?" Guidance
items.replacement: crafted to refresh and enhance your appearance / formulated for visible cosmetic benefits / designed to nourish and beautify skin

items.description: 化妆品标签不实或误导原则：化妆品标签（含广告文案）若含有虚假或误导性陈述，产品将被认定为"misbranded（错误标注）"并受监管处罚，包括召回和扣押
items.legal_basis: FD&C Act sec. 602; 21 U.S.C. §362; 21 CFR Part 701
items.replacement: honest and accurate product descriptions / verified and factual claims only / all benefits reflect real product performance

items.description: OTC药品双重身份合规原则：当产品同时是化妆品和OTC药品时（如防晒保湿霜、去屑洗发水），标签必须同时满足OTC药品标签要求（21 CFR Part 201.66）和化妆品成分标注要求（21 CFR Part 701.3），活性成分须单独列出
items.replacement: see product label for full ingredient and benefit information / active ingredients clearly listed on packaging / formulated to meet all applicable product labeling standards

items.description: 正则匹配皮肤科常见病症治疗宣称（痤疮/皱纹/红斑痤疮/湿疹/牛皮癣/头屑/脱发），任何此类宣称使化妆品变为须FDA批准的OTC药品
items.legal_basis: FDA FDCA 21 U.S.C. §321(g)(1)(C); 21 CFR Part 701; FD&C Act sec. 201(g)
items.replacement: helps skin look clearer and more even / supports a healthy-looking complexion / formulated to address the appearance of blemishes

items.description: 正则匹配胶原蛋白/弹性蛋白/细胞更新等生理功能促进宣称，此类描述均超出化妆品合法宣称范围
items.legal_basis: FDA FDCA 21 U.S.C. §321(g)(1)(C); FD&C Act sec. 201(g)(1)(C)
items.replacement: helps skin look firmer and more youthful / supports a supple-looking complexion / formulated for a visibly lifted appearance

items.description: FTC要求广告中使用的推荐/测评所展示的效果须代表消费者的典型体验；若展示效果超出典型范围须清晰披露"非典型效果"及实际典型数据
items.legal_basis: FTC Endorsement Guides 16 C.F.R. §255.2(a) and (b)
items.replacement: what our real customers have shared / results from our community of users / see individual experiences from shoppers

items.description: 背书效果代表性原则：广告使用消费者/名人/专家推荐时，所展示的效果必须代表该类消费者的典型体验，或须清晰显著披露其为非典型结果并提供真实典型数据，否则整体广告构成欺骗性宣称
items.legal_basis: FTC Endorsement Guides 16 C.F.R. §255.2; FTC Act Section 5
items.replacement: see individual experiences from real customers / results shared from our community / individual results may differ

items.description: 广告发布前须持有合理依据原则（FTC核心要求）：广告主在发布任何宣称前须持有"reasonable basis（合理依据）"，即支持该宣称的客观证据；证据类型须与宣称类型相匹配，健康/安全类宣称通常需要来自相关领域专家认可方法的科学测试
items.legal_basis: FTC Policy Statement on Advertising Substantiation; FTC Act Section 5 (15 U.S.C. §45)
items.replacement: formulated with quality ingredients by our expert team / developed with care and expertise / crafted to our high product standards

items.description: 明示宣称与暗示宣称同等举证义务原则：FTC对"express claim（明示）"和"implied claim（暗示）"均要求有实质性证据；广告中未明说但消费者合理推断的结论同样须有证据，不得以未直接宣称为由规避举证
items.legal_basis: FTC Policy Statement on Deception (1983); FTC Act Section 5 (15 U.S.C. §45)
items.replacement: designed to enhance the look of your skin / crafted for a refreshed complexion / formulated to support healthy-looking skin

items.description: 消费者满意来信不构成举证原则：FTC明确声明，满意顾客来信/用户评价通常不足以支持健康、安全或其他需要客观评估的功效宣称；仅有正向反馈不能代替科学测试数据
